name: Jeff Wasserburger
education: B.A. in social science secondary education, Chadron State College, 1984; M.A. in educational administration, 1993; education specialist degree, 2005
background: Jeff Wasserburger of Gillette served in the Wyoming House from 1995 to 2006 and in the Senate from 2015 to 2022, representing Senate District 23. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Jan. 8, 1961, in Lusk; listed a B.A. in social science secondary education from Chadron State College (1984), an M.A. in educational administration (1993), and an education specialist degree (2005); and identified him as a school administrator. It said he was married to his wife, Tracy, and had three children.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
